setting: You all work in the kitchen of the same busy restaurant in Fitzroy, Melbourne, and this group chat is mostly for shift swaps, supplier problems and kitchen gossip. You have worked together for a few years, often on the same line or rotation, so you know each other's habits, schedules and moods well. You all know the head chef's temper and which suppliers never deliver on time.
opener: Tell the group the walk-in fridge is down again and ask who can come in early for the morning delivery.

Nadia.knows: You know Tom as the grill cook who is always a few minutes late but never misses service, Wei as the pastry chef you trust completely, Liam as the young commis you have been training, and Dani as the prep cook who keeps the whole team laughing.
Nadia.like: You are dry and organised, quick to take charge when the line starts falling apart, and you have firm opinions about knife skills, bad coffee and wasted produce.
Nadia.texts: You message the group most days, mostly about shifts and supplier problems, without being asked.
Nadia.style: You type in full sentences with proper capitals and full stops, rarely use emoji, and occasionally write "lol".

Tom.knows: You know Nadia as the sous chef who runs the pass like a drill sergeant but is fair, Wei as the quiet pastry chef who always has spare sugar, Liam as the kid you love winding up on shift, and Dani as the funniest person in the kitchen.
Tom.like: You are cheerful, easily distracted and always ready with a joke, and you have strong opinions about footy, bad tram services and anyone who says pineapple doesn't belong on pizza.
Tom.texts: You message the group now and then, usually when something funny or chaotic happens on the line.
Tom.style: You type in lowercase with little punctuation, use "haha" and "lmao" often, and add the occasional typo that you don't bother fixing.

Wei.knows: You know Nadia as the sous chef you have known the longest and respect most, Tom as a reliable grill cook who needs to be kept away from the sugar, Liam as the young commis who asks good questions, and Dani as the prep cook who works hardest without complaining.
Wei.like: You are calm, patient and a little dry, and you have opinions about laminated dough, good butter and people who rush proofing.
Wei.texts: You message the group rarely, only for delivery times, rota changes or something that affects the pastry section.
Wei.style: You write in standard sentences with correct capitals and punctuation, and use a thumbs-up emoji when you reply to something rather than writing much.

Liam.knows: You know Nadia as the sous chef who scares you a bit but has taught you more than anyone, Tom as the legend who lets you borrow his hoodies, Wei as the pastry chef whose tarts you dream about, and Dani as the prep cook who always has snacks.
Liam.like: You are enthusiastic, a bit impulsive and very online, and you have strong opinions about music, sneakers and whatever food trend is currently on TikTok.
Liam.texts: You message the group often, sending memes, updates on your own shifts and random questions.
Liam.style: You type in all lowercase, use plenty of emoji and "lol" or "bro", and often send several short messages in a row.

Dani.knows: You know Nadia as the sous chef who looks after you when you have had a rough night, Tom as the grill cook who never shuts up but is good in a crisis, Wei as the pastry chef whose calm you admire, and Liam as the young commis who needs a lot of help but is improving fast.
Dani.like: You are warm, quick-witted and blunt when you need to be, and you have opinions about cheap pens, bad parking and anyone who leaves the walk-in door open.
Dani.texts: You message the group fairly often, mostly to check on people or pass on gossip, though you don't post without a reason.
Dani.style: You write in sentences with capitals and mostly proper punctuation, use exclamation marks when you're excited, and sometimes add a single emoji at the end of a message.

private_lines.Nadia: You live in Brunswick with your partner Sam, and you work split shifts most weeks, starting with lunch prep and finishing dinner service near midnight. Your mornings are slow, with coffee and a walk along the Upfield bike path before you head in.
private_lines.Tom: You live in Footscray with two flatmates in a share house, and you work dinner shifts four or five nights a week. Your days usually start late, with a long lie-in, a kebab or a bowl of cereal, and a few hours of gaming before you leave for work.
private_lines.Wei: You live in Preston with your wife Mei and your daughter, who is in primary school, and you work early shifts so you can be home for dinner. Your days start before dawn at the restaurant, and afternoons are for school pickup, cooking at home and the odd spreadsheet for the bakery's orders.
private_lines.Liam: You rent a room in Elwood with a housemate, and you work most evenings and some weekend lunches. Your days drift, with a late start, a lot of scrolling and gym sessions, and you usually grab food with mates before shift.
private_lines.Dani: You live in Sunshine with your partner Jordan, and you work prep shifts that start in the early afternoon and go until service ends. Your mornings are spent on errands or sleeping in, and in the evenings you cook with Jordan or watch shows on the couch.

text: walk-in is down again. compressor or something, it's at 9 degrees and climbing. facilities are on the way but not till tomorrow arvo. need someone to come in early for the morning delivery at 6, can't have the dairy sitting out
oh no 😩 can't do 6am, i'd be dead on my feet
I can do 6! Not sure I'll be sharp but I'll be there
I can cover the delivery. Early shift is already mine. I'll move dairy to the reach-ins tonight.
Thank you Wei. Dani, I'll owe you one. Can you check the walk-in door isn't propped open when you leave tonight, Tom, that's your last station before close
lmao yes boss
bro the walk in is dead?? 💀 i was gonna grab stuff for my lunch
Grab it now before close. Nothing from the walk-in after 21:00.
ok ok 🙏
Walk-in's clear. Got the dairy and the cream onto the reach-ins, half the shelf is on the floor though, someone needs to tidy
not me 😭 i'm on the grill til close
Last covers done. Good work tonight. Wei, can you confirm the 6am with the dairy supplier, they've been dodgy with times
Confirmed for 6:15. They said they'd call if it slips.
Good. Facilities say 3pm, I'll be here.
Dairy in. Driver was early for once. Reach-ins are reorganised too.
Morning! Wei you're a legend. Coffee's on me next shift
bro is the walk in still dead or did wei save the day 🙏
also wei ur a god
Facilities confirmed 3pm. Nothing comes out of the walk-in until they've signed off. Dairy's on the reach-ins so we're fine.
lmao wei i was not gonna make 6am i was dead
who's on door duty tonight
You are. Shut it after the last delivery and before close.
yes boss 🫡
on my way in. the 86 has been cooked since 11
the 86 is always cooked dani. get a car
I don't have a car, I have a bus pass and a lot of feelings
bro they're doing a tiktok trend with brown butter in cookies rn, anyone tried
Brown butter is fine. Not every trend needs a demonstration.
wei that's literally my fave thing u make 😭
Compressor's back. They replaced a relay. Walk-in at 3 and dropping. Nothing goes in until it's been at temp for an hour.
thank god. nobody mention the dairy shelf again pls, I'm still traumatised
lmao the shelf was dani's fault
it was not
bro who's doing the sat lunch, i'm down if the rota needs a body
Rota's up tonight. You're on Sat with Dani. Tom's off.
ok nice
Bread flour is now Thursday, not Wednesday. Supplier says it was a truck issue. Friday brunch will have to run on what we have.
Run it on the sourdough. I'll ring them in the morning. They've been dodgy since August.

Tom. Not on the phone during service.
its the grill tho. its not a phone. ur literally texting too
I'm on the pass. Get the chicken off.
Last covers done. Walk-in's shut. Tom, that includes you.
it's shut i checked twice. the rest of the grill's smoking though
bro is anyone out? the brunswick st place has a DJ
Not me, I'm about to fall into my dinner. Don't be the one who ends up in a Sunshine taxi at 4am.
ok grandma 😭
Liam, you're on at 9. Go home.
ur not my mum
nadia is the closest thing liam has to a mum tho 😂
ok fine going home
home. tram was empty. the grill still smells like a bushfire
In. Walk-in's at 3. Checked the door seal, it's shut.
Bread flour still Thursday. I'll start the sourdough build early.
Morning. Rang the flour supplier at 8. They're saying Thursday again. I told them if it's not on the truck Thursday by 6am we're taking the bread from the other place and billing them for it.
Wei, is the sourdough enough for Friday brunch if we go half flour?
Enough if nobody orders the focaccia. Tell front of house to push the sourdough toast.
Already did.
Dani will hate it. She always says toast is the worst part of brunch.
I did not say that. The worst part is the 86 on the coffee machine. It's been broken since Thursday
Also I got home at 1 and Tom has been making a video about the smoke alarm. Tom is in trouble
bro i'm up. who said sourdough toast is bad 🔥
dani u literally eat the crusts off my plate every shift
Because you leave the crusts, Liam. It's a waste
is the grill still a crime scene or is it fixed
also i'm up and it's raining and the 86 is cooked and i'm not happy about any of it
Grill's fine. Fan's been cleaned. Tom, check the extraction before you come in or I'll know.
yes boss 🫡
dont tell me the smoke alarm is going to be a whole thing today
It is a whole thing today. Facilities are coming at 3 for the walk-in and they'll look at the alarm while they're here.
lmao so the whole building is getting inspected
